entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonino da Patti was a Sicilian priest. In 1596 he was made an apostolic visitor for the Order of Reformed Friars Minor in the Terra di Lavoro. He suffered many persecutions, and died in Rome in 1617. He was buried at the church of San Francesco a Ripa.
